raw_graphql_pull_request.body: Fixes #63615. Emits KV-cache tensors only for layers the worker actually owns, so the `next()` lookup in `allocate_kv_cache` (`worker/utils.py`) always matches under PP. When a pipeline rank owns none of a group's layers, the worker-side projection keeps the group's global `UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs` unfiltered while emptying its `layer_names`; the planner loop then iterates the unfiltered spec and emits tensors naming other ranks' layers, and the consumer-side lookup raises a bare `StopIteration` — surfacing on the *other* rank as an opaque `Worker failed` error (full analysis in the issue). The diff targets the planner loop in `kv_cache_planning.py`; on the v0.31.0 image the same pair lives at `kv_cache_utils.py:1792` (loop) and `:2666` (projection guard) — the code moved between the two, the bug didn't. We considered the projection-side alternative (dropping the `worker_layer_names and` guard so an empty rank gets an empty spec) and took the filter instead: no change to `UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs` validation semantics. **Test** (in `tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_planning.py`): builds real `KVCacheGroupSpec` objects with a `UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs`, projects them through `_project_kv_cache_groups_to_worker` with a worker spec that omits every layer of that group — producing the actual failing state (empty `layer_names`, unfiltered global spec) — runs the planner, and asserts every emitted tensor's layer names are a subset of the worker's. Reproduced red/green on the v0.31.0 form of the same code: the unpatched planner emits tensors for layers the worker does not own (`[['layer1', 'layer2']]`); the patched one emits none. Generic PP hygiene, model-independent; verified on a two-rank PP2 hybrid-KV deployment where the crash reproduced deterministically before the fix and never after. Working overlay and receipts: https://github.com/ebfio/deepseek-v41-flash-pp2-pair --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. --- Need help on this PR? detail.title: [Bugfix][PP] Filter KV-cache tensors to worker-owned layers

files.patch:
@@ -2172,3 +2172,64 @@ def test_kv_cache_groups_tp_replicas(specs, tp_size, dcp_size, expected):
     """Replicas are the gcd of each layer's tp_size // max_tp_shards."""
     groups = [KVCacheGroupSpec([f"l.{i}"], spec) for i, spec in enumerate(specs)]
     assert kv_cache_groups_tp_replicas(groups, tp_size, dcp_size) == expected
+
+
+def test_pp_worker_owning_no_uniform_group_layers_gets_no_foreign_tensors():
+    """A PP rank that owns none of a UniformType group's layers must not be
+    handed tensors naming other ranks' layers.
+
+    The worker-side projection keeps the global (unfiltered)
+    UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs on a group when the rank owns none of its
+    layers; the planner must then emit no tensors for that group, or
+    allocate_kv_cache's next()-based group lookup raises StopIteration
+    (observed on a PP2 hybrid-KV deployment where one rank owned none of
+    a group's layers and died at final KV allocation).
+    """
+    spec = new_kv_cache_spec()
+    shared = UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs(
+        block_size=spec.block_size,
+        kv_cache_specs={"layer1": spec, "layer2": spec},
+    )
+    groups = [
+        KVCacheGroupSpec(["layer1", "layer2"], shared),
+        KVCacheGroupSpec(["layer3"], spec),
+    ]
+    # This worker owns layer3 only: the UniformType group has none of its
+    # layers, so the projection leaves the global spec unfiltered.
+    worker_spec = {"layer3": spec}
+    projected = kv_cache_planning._project_kv_cache_groups_to_worker(
+        groups, worker_spec
+    )
+    assert projected[0].layer_names == []
+    assert set(projected[0].kv_cache_spec.kv_cache_specs) == {"layer1", "layer2"}
+
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        attention_config=SimpleNamespace(hisparse_config=None),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            hf_config=SimpleNamespace(index_topk=128),
+            max_model_len=16,
+        ),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            tensor_parallel_size=1,
+            pipeline_parallel_size=1,
+            prefill_context_parallel_size=1,
+            decode_context_parallel_size=1,
+            world_size=1,
+            distributed_executor_backend="mp",
+            nnodes_within_dp=1,
+        ),
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            num_gpu_blocks_override=7,
+            prefix_cache_retention_interval=None,
+            get_resolved_kv_cache_layout=lambda: KVCacheLayout.BLHNC,
+        ),
+    )
+    cache_config = kv_cache_planning.get_kv_cache_config_from_groups(
+        config, projected, available_memory=2**30
+    )
+    owned = {"layer3"}
+    for tensor in cache_config.kv_cache_tensors:
+        assert set(tensor.layers) <= owned, (
+            "planner emitted tensors for layers the worker does not own: "
+            f"{tensor.layers}"
+        )
